note: Premature complete after auth failure on file_system.

strategies.name: BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION
strategies.guidance: Do not complete due to auth failure. Get password from supervisor.show_account_passwords, login to file_system, keep access_token, finish the required vacation file operations, then complete.

strategies.name: VERIFY_TARGET_SET
strategies.guidance: Before complete_task, confirm you have a valid file_system access_token and that the required vacation file operations are finished. If auth or moves are incomplete, finish them first.

strategies.name: REPLAN
strategies.guidance: Do not complete. Re-plan: show_account_passwords -> file_system.login -> show_directory -> perform required file operations with access_token -> verify listing -> complete_task().

strategies.name: LOOKUP_API_SPEC
strategies.guidance: Do not complete due to auth failure. show_api_doc(file_system.login), get password from supervisor.show_account_passwords, login, keep access_token, then finish vacation file operations before completing.
